5612-5913-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5612-5913-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5170-6132-8250-8292.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

751-3286-4785.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5470-7730-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

3129-3899-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3129-3899-5254.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1479-2841-3318-4488.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-4488.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Rampaging Baloths and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-1445-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
728-1445-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-5131-6495-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7010--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1558-3875-4231-5621-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3875-4231-5621-7810.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3668-5361.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-5361.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Auton Soldier each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-5361.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3532-5078-7010-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7010-7750.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-5078-7010-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

955-1368-4289-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
955-1368-4289-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

643-2511-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-2511-4302.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
1123-4050-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

628-4050-5007.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

215-850-3464.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-850-3464.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-4460-5147.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4053-5499-7296--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5499-7296--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

203-1494-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
203-1494-4613-7152.description:
Cast Anoint with buyback by paying {3}{W}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
203-1494-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Anoint. Anoint is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1032-1438.easyPrerequisites:
Power of Fire attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1032-1438.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1032-1438.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1251-2366-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1251-2366-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-4477--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-4477--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

3532-5078-5240-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2060-2906-4770-6930.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
2060-2906-4770-6930.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

739-3473.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
739-3473.notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials' emblem. Gideon of the Trials is on the battlefield, or you control a Gideon planeswalker.
739-3473.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
739-3473.notes: Note that if all Gideon planeswalkers you control are removed from the battlefield, you will lose the game due to Transcendence's effect.

325-2428-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2428-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

224-225-765-1772.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-765-1772.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

2281-3175-5686.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1429-2018-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3174-5256-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
3174-5256-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

56-4054-4556-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-4556-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-4556-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

4559-4875-5686.notablePrerequisites:
The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Angel" chosen.
4559-4875-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a number of Blood tokens equal to Metalwork Colossus's toughness.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4929-5113-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2080-3277-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
2080-3277-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

91-5086-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-5086-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Triskelavus' ability by paying {1} and removing the +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Triskelavite tokens, you may sacrifice them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

3263-3598-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Rapacious One.
3263-3598-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the five Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {5}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
